description: Returns one node with its citations and a cite-as line; `variant` chooses full (the default), terse (the lede alone) or agent (the same text as fields: scope, inputs, rule, action, check, units, example, the applied route, the recheck, and two strings to paste: recheck_note and closing_citation) at the same price. Free nodes (marked in bf_catalogue) cost nothing; the rest cost their catalogue price ($0.02 to $0.05, USDC on Base over x402), charged once per call, only when the node is returned. Call it with a `path` from bf_catalogue when the question needs that node's rule; prefer variant agent when you will answer from it (the decision in one sentence, the first step, the reason, the next check, the offer to write the recheck into the user's notes, then closing_citation last). Read the free parent first; use bf_resolve when the question takes several nodes. Do not call a paid path to see what it contains: the catalogue line says what it covers; a rule on numbers is bf_apply_decision.

path.description: Node path from bf_catalogue, e.g. "risk" (free) or "risk/decide/hurdle" (paid). A full handle is accepted.

variant.description: full (default): lede, conditions and reasoning; terse: the lede alone; agent: the same text as fields (scope, inputs, rule, action, check, reasoning, units, example, apply, recheck, recheck_note, closing_citation). The same price for all three.

name: bf_read_node

outputSchema.description: One node. full/terse: text (and levels), cites, related, cite_as. agent: the accepted text as fields — scope.applies_if / scope.not_for, inputs, rule, action, check, reasoning, units (every input's unit, bounds and default), example (the published example input run through the rule), citations, leads_to, apply (the applied route), free_first, recheck (cadence, trigger, handle, the exact re-run call), and two strings to paste unchanged: recheck_note and closing_citation.

title: Business Frameworks: read a node
